title: Metroid × Emerald
save_policy: fresh progress; independent artifact identity; no automatic migration

parent_games.role: extracted native combat code, tables and sprite assets

design_choices.label: Side-view world
design_choices.implementation: Retain actual room rendering, collision, camera, HUD and world source

design_choices.label: Metroid movement
design_choices.implementation: Retain native Samus code and all campaign equipment behaviors

design_choices.label: Explore and unlock
design_choices.implementation: Retain entire campaign, native equipment gates, bosses, maps and save system

design_choices.label: Pokémon encounters
design_choices.implementation: Verbatim Emerald damage/type functions plus move/type/species tables; explicit reduced singles AI and turn bridge
design_choices.fidelity: adapted subset; full AI bytecode interpreter and trainer item policy are not ported

design_choices.label: Area changes the matchup
design_choices.implementation: Map current MZM area modulo three to clear/rain/sun; extracted Emerald damage calculation reads native weather bits
design_choices.fidelity: new cross-game mapping; Emerald overworld weather renderer is not ported

design_choices.label: Zebes campaign
design_choices.implementation: Retain actual story, rooms, assets and campaign structure

design_choices.label: Three Pokémon party
design_choices.implementation: Actual Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle source stats and first-frame front/back art; bridge-configured moves and level; resets per encounter

design_choices.label: Isolation with tactical encounters
design_choices.implementation: Inherited Metroid presentation; native turn-based encounter detours

dependency_decisions.resolution: Use original pause fade, PauseScreenInit OBJ/palette backups and GM_INGAME reload path; combat owns native Mode3 only while paused
SELECT explicitly enters; observed nonzero health loss also enters after cooldown. Health-loss trigger includes hazards and does not identify or remove a specific enemy
Victory restores 8 energy up to native cap; defeat halves nontrivial energy; retreat returns without award; 180 gameplay-frame encounter cooldown
Bridge exposes only reviewed singles/no held-items/no gym-badges/no field-sports battler states; do not claim arbitrary Emerald state support
Retain the original request separately. Former 12x8 toy grid bounds do not truncate the actual campaign. Human clarification selects side-view platforming with Pokémon combat

required: move changes native HP and PP

unsupported: Arbitrary ontology bundles are not automatically linkable
Complete Emerald battle scripts, trainer item AI, catching, evolution and persistent Pokémon party
Automatic native enemy removal after encounter
